_comment: Stage 4 (Intelligence) — serverless churn ML job: train -> score -> sync predictions to Lakebase. Deploy: import ml/train_churn_model.py and ml/score_churn.py to the workspace as NOTEBOOKs (databricks workspace import ... --format AUTO), then databricks jobs create --json @ml/churn_ml_job.json (adjust notebook_path prefixes to match your workspace). Serverless (no cluster blocks); deps installed via %pip in each notebook. The sync_predictions task reuses serving/reverse_etl.py with job parameters pointing at churn_predictions. Runs daily, paused by default.
name: dev-churn-ml-scoring
